$comment: Khmer Kingdoms campaign (D53). One big map of Greater Angkor laid out like the Build tab's map (config/map.json, map units x scale metres); every temple from temples.json stands at its site, in order. Completing a chapter's temple ends its era: the next temple, era, year and content unlock. Opponents follow recorded history where it exists; 'from' is where their raids come from (map units). Khmer text drafted by Claude: PK to review.

opponents.km: មេកន្ទ្រាញ
opponents.notes: No war is documented for these years. The raiding chiefdom is invented to give the chapter an opponent.

opponents.km: អ្នកដណ្ដើមរាជ្យ
opponents.notes: Inscriptions record succession wars (c. 1002–1010) and revolts under Udayadityavarman II. Their raids on the building site here are gameplay.

Wars with Champa are recorded: Rajendravarman II's campaign (c. 945–946), the Cham sack of Yasodharapura (1177) and Jayavarman VII's wars. Cham soldiers wear the lotus-like headdress shown on the Bayon reliefs. Which side attacked when varied; raids on the building site are gameplay.
Vietnamese annals record wars with Suryavarman II (1128–1138). The soldiers' look here is a gameplay abstraction, not a reconstruction; raids on the building site are gameplay.

history.km: ប្រាង្គឥដ្ឋ ៦ ឧទ្ទិសដល់ដូនតា និងព្រះរាជវង្ស។
history.en: Six brick towers dedicated to the king's ancestors.

history.km: ប្រាសាទភ្នំធំដំបូងគេ ជាប្រាសាទរដ្ឋរបស់ព្រះបាទឥន្ទ្រវរ្ម័នទី១។
history.en: The first great temple mountain, the state temple of Indravarman I.

history.km: សាងលើកោះកណ្ដាលបារាយណ៍ឥន្ទ្រតដាក ដោយព្រះបាទយសោវរ្ម័នទី១។
history.en: Built on an island in the Indratataka reservoir by Yasovarman I.

event.km: ព្រះបាទយសោវរ្ម័នទី១ ផ្លាស់រាជធានីទៅយសោធរបុរៈ ជុំវិញភ្នំបាខែង។
event.en: Yasovarman I moves the capital to Yasodharapura, around Phnom Bakheng.

history.km: ប្រាសាទភ្នំលើភ្នំធម្មជាតិ ជាចំណុចកណ្ដាលនៃរាជធានីថ្មីយសោធរបុរៈ។
history.en: A temple mountain on a natural hill, centre of the new capital Yasodharapura.

event.km: រាជធានីនៅកោះកេរ (៩២៨–៩៤៤) រួចត្រឡប់មកអង្គរវិញ ក្នុងរជ្ជកាលព្រះបាទរាជេន្ទ្រវរ្ម័នទី២។
event.en: The capital was at Koh Ker (928–944), then returned to Angkor under Rajendravarman II.

history.km: សាងលើកោះកណ្ដាលបារាយណ៍ខាងកើត ដោយព្រះបាទរាជេន្ទ្រវរ្ម័នទី២។ ដំរីថ្មឈរនៅជ្រុងៗ។
history.en: Built on an island in the East Baray by Rajendravarman II; stone elephants stand at its corners.

history.km: ប្រាសាទរដ្ឋរបស់ព្រះបាទរាជេន្ទ្រវរ្ម័នទី២ ធ្វើពីឥដ្ឋ និងថ្មបាយក្រៀម។
history.en: State temple of Rajendravarman II, of brick and laterite.

history.km: សាងដោយមន្ត្រីយជ្ញវរាហៈ មិនមែនស្ដេចទេ។ ល្បីដោយចម្លាក់ថ្មភក់ពណ៌ផ្កាឈូក។
history.en: Built by the courtier Yajnavaraha, not a king; famous for fine carving in pink sandstone.

history.km: ប្រាសាទភ្នំធ្វើពីថ្មភក់ទាំងស្រុងដំបូងគេ ប៉ុន្តែសាងមិនទាន់ចប់ (គ្មានចម្លាក់)។
history.en: The first temple mountain built all in sandstone, left unfinished and uncarved.

history.km: ប្រាសាទភ្នំខ្ពស់របស់ព្រះបាទឧទយាទិត្យវរ្ម័នទី២។
history.en: The towering temple mountain of Udayadityavarman II.

history.km: ប្រាសាទធំបំផុតលើលោក ឧទ្ទិសដល់ព្រះវិស្ណុ បែរមុខទៅទិសខាងលិច។
history.en: The world's largest religious monument, dedicated to Vishnu, facing west.

event.km: ឆ្នាំ ១១៧៧ ចាម្ប៉ាវាយយកយសោធរបុរៈ។ ឆ្នាំ ១១៨១ ព្រះបាទជ័យវរ្ម័នទី៧ ឡើងគ្រងរាជ្យ។
event.en: In 1177 Champa sacked Yasodharapura. In 1181 Jayavarman VII became king.

history.km: សាងដោយព្រះបាទជ័យវរ្ម័នទី៧ ឧទ្ទិសដល់ព្រះមាតា។
history.en: Built by Jayavarman VII in honour of his mother.

history.km: ឧទ្ទិសដល់ព្រះបិតា។ តាមការនិទាន សាងនៅកន្លែងជ័យជម្នះលើចាម្ប៉ា។
history.en: Dedicated to the king's father; by tradition built on the site of a victory over Champa.

history.km: ប្រាសាទកណ្ដាលអង្គរធំ មានប្រាង្គមុខធំៗជាច្រើន។
history.en: The temple at the centre of Angkor Thom, crowned with many great face towers.
